find: if (!wasOpen) for (const cb of openCbs) cb();
killedBy: createControllersPane (issue #556) fires the open callbacks once per REAL transition, not once per show(true)
why: Fires the open subscribers on a `show(true)` that transitions nothing. `loop.ts` starts polling gamepads off this callback and stops off its pair, so a redundant open leaves a poller running with no close to match it. Measured when the pane was extracted: this survives all 341 cases in hud.surfaces, hud.controls and hud.navigation, because the real host's transition runner hides the redundancy from anything driving through `createHud`. That is exactly the gap a module test is for, and it is why this case exists rather than a second copy of a `createHud` assertion.
